description: Schwarz-Christoffel mappings provide explicit conformal maps from the disk to polygonal domains. Combined with interval arithmetic, this enables rigorous, computer-verified bounds on the Bloch constant.
mathematical_formalization: SC map f(z) = A + C int_0^z prod_{k=1}^n (1 - zeta/z_k)^{alpha_k - 1} dzeta. Interval version: [f]([z]) supset { f(z) : z in [z] }.
analogical_connections: Interval SC mapping ~ error-bounded finite element analysis
Rigorous enclosure of conformal map ~ formal verification of software
SC parameter problem ~ inverse problem in tomography
implementation_hypothesis: Extend SC Toolbox with interval arithmetic (Julia IntervalArithmetic.jl). Compute rigorous enclosures for candidate extremal polygonal domains.
experiment_seed: Verify rigorous bound for infinite strip inradius pi/4. Then apply to n-gon approximations of Carroll-Ortega-Cerda domain.
